description: Java class representing client transactions within the Fineract microfinance platform. This entity manages transaction details such as amount, date, type, associated client, office, and payment details, and supports payment, waiver, and reversal operations.

classes.name: ClientTransaction
classes.description: Entity representing a financial transaction associated with a client, including details like amount, date, type, and related charges.

methods.name: payCharge
methods.description: Factory method to create a payment transaction for a client charge with specific details.

methods.name: waiver
methods.description: Factory method to create a waiver transaction for a client, representing waived charges.

methods.name: toMapData
methods.description: Converts the transaction entity into a map suitable for accounting module processing.

methods.name: isPayChargeTransaction
methods.description: Checks if the transaction is a charge payment.

methods.name: isWaiveChargeTransaction
methods.description: Checks if the transaction is a charge waiver.

methods.name: getClientChargePaidByCollection
methods.description: Returns the set of charges paid in this transaction.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the associated client.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client entity associated with this transaction.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the transaction amount as a Money object.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency of the transaction as a MonetaryCurrency object.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for the transaction.

methods.name: getCurrencyCode
methods.description: Returns the currency code associated with the transaction.

methods.name: isReversed
methods.description: Indicates whether the transaction has been reversed.

methods.name: getTransactionDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the transaction occurred.

methods.name: getSubmittedOnDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the transaction was submitted.

methods.name: getExternalId
methods.description: Returns the external ID associated with the transaction.
